aggregation.all_evaluated_support: integrate every applicable tuple independently per operator
aggregation.common_support_integration: integrate ordered tuples on elapsed interval [0, common_partial_support_seconds), splitting the final tuple exactly at the boundary without interpolation
aggregation.full_support_hour: both operators have contiguous non-overlapping tuples totaling exactly 3600 seconds
aggregation.primary_site_summary: Python statistics.median across screen-eligible water-year samples
aggregation.trajectory_claim: prohibited: daily source snapshots are condition samples, not a persistent seasonal trajectory

decision.initial_projection_difference: raw-source identity passes and first effective input fingerprint differs, or any first active mass/depth/cold/temperature/layer-membership operand differs above its reconstruction tolerance
decision.lineage_failure_precedence: suppresses causal interpretation; remaining classes are not evaluated as causes
decision.multilabel_policy: after identity precedence, PREDECESSOR_NOT_REPRODUCED, INITIAL_CONTROL_VOLUME_PROJECTION_DIFFERENCE, STATE_EVOLUTION_RECONCILES_SIGN_CONTRADICTION, and SUPPORT_CENSORING_MATERIALLY_CONTRIBUTES may coexist and are reported in listed order
decision.state_evolution_class: requires positive predecessor reproduction, negative same-state Snowbird estimator, reconstruction and delta closure, invariant shortwave, and either matching first effective inputs or an independently reconstructed frozen-active-projection reference separating projection from later evolution
decision.support_materiality: complete external-subset delta changes sign between common and all-evaluated support, or omitted-support energy exceeds 0.05 * all-evaluated sum_abs_operands

execution.control_per_site: same binary and selectors with evaluation disabled
execution.head_policy: runner requires a caller-supplied full reviewed commit SHA and exact clean HEAD before build, before analysis, and before acceptance

join.hour_expansion: after a unique daily join, expand arrays positionally using hour_index 0..23
join.effective_input_policy: first effective carrier-input fingerprints are compared as an estimand and are not required to match

operators.same_state_paired_carrier_v1: whole-column projection held immutable; one 3600-second tuple per evaluated hour
operators.sequential_resolved_shadow_v1: existing active-volume alignment/normalization and dynamic substeps; every evaluated substep emitted
operators.frozen_active_projection_reference: consumer-side diagnostic reconstruction using the sequential operator's first effective carrier input held fixed; never a runtime operator, owner, or production state

predecessor.estimand: Python statistics.median across 35 Snowbird WY1990-2024 window sums of stage3_shadow_complete_energy_j_m2, October 1 through earliest maximum positive observed SWE date inclusive

reconstruction.hourly_energy_j_m2: sum independently reconstructed tuple flux_w_m2 * tuple_duration_seconds

support.primary_window: October 1 through earliest maximum positive observed SWE date inclusive
support.zero_support: tuple absent and hourly applicability false with an enumerated reason; no numeric endpoint or transfer value is serialized as a zero alias

tuple.ordering: hour_index, then substep_index; elapsed_start_seconds must equal prior elapsed_end_seconds
tuple.sequential_duration: existing dynamic substep duration without alteration

no_tuning: No result-driven change to cohort, forcing, operators, projection definitions, joins, windows, support, aggregation, tolerances, predecessor estimand, or decision predicates in this namespace.
